evidence.reason: The shown `getPrReadiness` passes a `statusCheckRollup` read directly into `readinessSnapshotOf` and neither requests `headRefOid` nor re-reads/compares the PR head before returning. Because `gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup` can paginate checks through additional current-head queries, a concurrent head change can mix check sets, and this adapter has no way to detect or reject it. That can make readiness report checks from the wrong head, so head-change rejection is a correctness repair rather than a new requirement.
